description: Comprehensive DEX/on-chain trader database with VERIFIED trade history from 7+ decentralized exchanges

gmx_v2_arbitrum.notes: Direct on-chain data via Subsquid indexer. PnL in raw format (divide by 1e30). No API key needed. Top 50 by realized PnL with >10 closed trades.

gmx_v2_avalanche.notes: Same as Arbitrum but lower volume. Some traders active on both chains.

hyperliquid.notes: Real-time account state via POST. Addresses discovered via recentTrades across 30+ coins, then filtered for accounts > $50K value.
hyperliquid.discovery_method: Scanned recentTrades for BTC/ETH/SOL + 27 altcoins. Checked clearinghouseState for each address. 110 addresses checked, 61 qualified.

dydx_v4.notes: dYdX v4 indexer now requires auth for address lookups. Copin provides pre-aggregated monthly leaderboard. 161+ active perpetual markets.

drift.notes: DLOB shows real-time orderbook and positions. Historical PnL requires Solana RPC + Drift SDK.

gmx_v2.description: GMX v2 Synthetics on Arbitrum/Avalanche — the gold standard for on-chain perps data
gmx_v2.query_top_traders: POST to subsquid URL with GraphQL: { accountStats(orderBy: realizedPnl_DESC, limit: 50, where: {closedCount_gt: 10}) { id wins losses realizedPnl volume closedCount realizedFees } }
gmx_v2.query_open_positions: { positions(where: {account_eq: "ADDRESS", isSnapshot_eq: false, sizeInUsd_gt: "0"}) { market isLong sizeInUsd entryPrice } }
gmx_v2.query_trade_history: { positionChanges(where: {account_eq: "ADDRESS"}, orderBy: timestamp_DESC, limit: 100) { account marketAddress isLong sizeInUsd collateralAmount timestamp } }
gmx_v2.pnl_format: Raw BigInt - divide by 1e30 to get USD

hyperliquid.description: Hyperliquid L1 perpetuals — real-time position tracking
hyperliquid.query_meta: POST with {"type": "meta"} for available markets (175+ perps)
hyperliquid.address_discovery: Scan recentTrades across multiple coins to discover active addresses
